reviewMethod: Sixteen previously unreviewed stored body figures across four current-corpus papers were independently reviewed from immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact 10785035374, continuing publication-date priority after the already-reviewed 2026-09-12 JACS/Organic Letters items. Each file was checked against DOI-bound page/article/source provenance, original figure/scheme label and independent caption, exact frozen bytes/full SHA256 and evidence fingerprint, media generation 1790082000000, article theme, image role, duplicate/recommended-image and TOC-substitution risk, format, and clarity. All fifteen SVG files were rendered and checked to contain no script, foreignObject, event-handler, or external href; the one PNG decoded cleanly at its stored dimensions. Figure 1 items are body figures, not TOC replacements, and the existing official TOCs are separately preserved. JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c12740 has a partial article-level capture history; approval is restricted to the six exact DOI-bound stored files listed here and does not infer approval of any missing figure or a cause for prior transport/server failures. No publisher recrawl, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature-data change, userscript change, quarantine-generation change, or production deployment is authorized by this packet.
